card.name: Serious infections in boxed warnings
card.fires_on: The word infection(s), or the start of INFECTIONS in capitals, right after "serious" in boxed warnings about immune-suppressing drugs. Also fires on related infection terms like latent tuberculosis.

modes.label: Infections after serious
modes.description: The word infections or infection right after "serious" in a risk statement.
modes.example: Patients treated with infliximab products are at increased risk for developing serious<< infections>> that may lead to hospitalization or death

modes.label: Capitalized INFECTIONS in warning titles
modes.description: The inner piece of INFECTIONS split in an all-caps boxed warning heading.
modes.example: WARNING: RISK OF SERIOUS IN<<FE>>CTIONS See full prescribing information for complete boxed

modes.label: Other infection terms
modes.description: Infection-related words in the same warnings, such as latent tuberculosis or a comma in a list of infection types.
modes.example: Treatment of latent<< tuberculosis>> infection prior to therapy with TNF-block

card.plain: It lights up on the word infections in warnings that immune-lowering drugs raise the risk of serious infections.
